Post 1

ASX 200 flatlined at 8,731.20, down just 1.20 points Friday. But beneath the surface, gold stocks surged while property and energy sold off hard. The index masks a market quietly rotating under the hood. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2

⛏️ Materials led all sectors, up 1.60%. A-REITs were the worst, down 1.31%, with Energy close behind at -1.10%. Property pain is real — rate-sensitive sectors taking the hit while hard assets find buyers. #ASX #mining #property

Post 3

🔺 4DMedical jumped 13.42% to AUD 4.31, the session's standout. Meanwhile Xero shed 4.08% to AUD 62.78 — tech was a mixed bag, not a trend. #ASX #ausbiz #healthcare

Post 4

🪙 Gold at AUD 6,219.24/oz with AUD/USD at 0.7127. A weaker Aussie dollar is amplifying local gold prices — that's the tailwind lifting Materials while the rest of the market drifts. #ASX #gold #metals #ausbiz

Post 5

Gold holding above AUD 6,200/oz is the line to watch. If AUD/USD slips further, local miners get a free kick. Does Materials extend its lead next week, or does the broader index finally pick a direction? Your call. #ASX #ausbiz #gold
